## TalkBack Checklist

- [ ] Every new interactive element has a clear accessibility label or content description
- [ ] Focus order is logical when swiping with TalkBack
- [ ] Headers and section titles are exposed as headings where appropriate
- [ ] Toggle, selected, loading, and error states are announced correctly
- [ ] Important status changes are not conveyed by color alone
- [ ] Tap targets are large enough for accessibility guidance
- [ ] Text scales without clipping at larger font sizes
- [ ] Dynamic content updates remain understandable for screen-reader users
